bio: State Representative Richard Hayes proudly represents Texas House District 57 in the heart of Denton County. Since his election in 2022, he has remained focused on addressing the challenges facing Texans. He has established himself as a conservative leader and strong advocate for issues such as property tax relief, limited government and reducing government bureaucracy, school choice, protecting children, and border security. During the 89th Legislative Session, Representative Hayes was appointed to serve on the Judiciary & Civil Jurisprudence Committee, the Pensions, Investments & Financial Services Committee, and the newly created House Select Committee on Governmental Oversight. He also serves as Vice Chairman of the Subcommittee on Family &.
